description: List passkey and EOA signers (with current threshold) for a subaccount. EOA ids here identify signers on this account and are used by `accounts update-signers --remove-eoa-ids`. To add an EOA, use its registration id from `auth signers` or `auth whoami` instead.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounts_signers
